# Fujairah Hospital Maternity Department

> The obstetrics and gynaecology department forms part of Al Fujairah Hospital, the largest government hospital in the United Arab Emirates' Eastern Region, which opened in 1984. The department provides maternity, antenatal and women's health services for the city and the surrounding east-coast communities. The wider hospital is internationally accredited and also offers emergency, cardiology, paediatric, surgical & diagnostic care.

## Project Overview

- Category: Advanced Technical Facilities
- Location: Fujairah, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

The Obstetrics & Gynaecology Department at Fujairah Hospital is a dedicated women's health and maternity facility within the public hospital in Fujairah. Delivered for the Ministry of Public Works & Housing, with B.W. Consulting Engineers as consultant, the project saw MENASCO execute the MEP works for the department. It reflects MENASCO's experience delivering building services for public healthcare facilities in the UAE.
